scenario: A buyer has a total budget of $80 and wants one over-ear headphone for home desk use through 2036. Open-back leakage is acceptable, and their source can drive 250-ohm headphones.
target: Audit the frozen product claims, rechargeable-battery limits, and long-use or repair anecdotes, then choose the best-supported route for the stated priorities without promising that any model will certainly survive to 2036.
